_about: p-Xylene (1) + Vinyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 97.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of p-xylene, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Kapoor, S.[Seema], Rattan, V. K., Vapor-Liquid Equilibria and Excess Properties of the Binary System Vinyl Acetate + p-Xylene, J. Chem. Eng. Data 50 (2005) 1897-1901
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.45 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
